ill_omen.label: Ill Omen
ill_omen.line: Each victory gathers more shadow until the omen passes.

debt.label: Debt
debt.line: The lender takes a share of each victory's gold until the debt is paid.

events.title: The Old Swordmaster
events.intro: An old woman is splitting firewood with a practice sword. She hasn't missed a log. "You're staring," she says, without looking up.

choices.label: Ask her to teach
choices.hint: She looks at your sword arm, not your face.

target.reason: No one here fights with a sword, lance or axe.

outcomes.text: She drills them until dark. "Again." Again. Then, at last: "Fine."
outcomes.fallbackText: She drills them until dark, then shakes her head. "Nothing left to show you." She feeds you instead.

outcomes.text: "No." She doesn't explain. She does, however, feed you.

choices.label: Spar with her
choices.hint: Quick hands and a sharp eye will matter more than talk.

target.reason: No one here fights with a sword, lance or axe.

outcomes.text: Their blade stops at her collar. She laughs, really laughs, and fetches something wrapped in oilcloth.
outcomes.fallbackText: Their blade stops at her collar. She laughs, and fetches something wrapped in oilcloth. "I've taught you all I know."

outcomes.text: She taps their wrist. The sword drops. "Dead," she says. "Twice."
She nods at the woodpile as you go. It's very neat.

events.title: The Abandoned Armory
events.intro: The garrison left in a hurry: boots by the door, a cold pot, racks of weapons nobody came back for. Somewhere inside, a door is barred from the wrong side.

choices.label: Take from the racks
choices.hint: Plain issue, oiled and ready.

outcomes.text: Plain issue, oiled and ready. Someone kept this place.

choices.label: Search the quartermaster's desk
choices.hint: Offices keep their best things where the wrong people won't look. Or where they will.

outcomes.text: Under a loose board: a fine weapon, badly kept.
A wire, a click, and the shelf comes down on whoever was first through the door. A few coins roll out of the wreckage.

choices.label: Force the barred door
choices.hint: Barred from the wrong side. Someone wanted something kept in.

outcomes.text: Someone was still home.

effects.victoryText: The door gives way to a cellar cache nobody had touched. Weapons, and a strongbox.

choices.label: Leave it be
choices.hint: Not your garrison, not your problem.

outcomes.text: Whatever they were running from, you leave it where it is.

events.title: The Twin Altar
events.intro: Two faces cut from one stone, one toward the sunrise and one toward the dark. There are offerings before both. More before the dark one.

choices.label: Pray to the Dawn
choices.hint: It asks for a coin. It doesn't promise to answer.

requires.reason: The Dawn has nothing left to give you.

outcomes.text: Warmth on the back of the neck, like a hand.
Nothing answers. The coin is gone anyway.

choices.label: Pray to the face in shadow
choices.hint: It asks for nothing. That is not the same as being free.

requires.reason: The dark face has nothing left to give you.

outcomes.text: It answers at once. That should have worried you more.

choices.label: Take the offerings
choices.hint: Gold, and the dark face watching you take it.

outcomes.text: The dark face is smiling. You're almost sure it wasn't before.

events.title: The Wounded Courier
events.intro: An imperial courier sits against a milestone with an arrow through his thigh and a sealed dispatch in his fist. He watches your banner and decides not to run.

choices.label: Tend his wound
choices.hint: It costs a Vulnerary use. Gratitude is another matter.

requires.reason: You have nothing to dress his wound with.

outcomes.text: He presses a worn seer's token into your hand. "For the road. Mine's done."
He is gone by morning. So is a purse.

choices.label: Read the dispatch
choices.hint: Imperial routes, in imperial handwriting.

outcomes.text: Patrol routes, three days old. You know where they won't be.

choices.label: Sell it at the next market
choices.hint: Seals are worth gold to someone.

outcomes.text: A clerk pays well for imperial seals and asks no questions.

events.title: Deserters' Fire
events.intro: Six imperial deserters around a fire too small for them. They've seen your banner. Nobody reaches for a weapon. Yet.

choices.label: Let them go
choices.hint: They are as tired as you are.

outcomes.text: "We won't forget." Deserters always say that. They leave you their rations.

choices.label: Take their gear
choices.hint: They won't hand it over politely.

outcomes.text: They reach for their weapons after all.

effects.victoryText: Not much worth carrying, but you carry it: a decent blade and a purse of coin.

choices.label: Turn them in
choices.hint: The Empire pays for deserters, and likes them found.

outcomes.text: The bounty is paid in clean coin. It doesn't feel clean.

events.title: The Echo
events.intro: At a crossroads cairn a voice you know asks you to stop. {fallen} is here. Mostly.

choices.label: Lay them to rest
choices.hint: A proper goodbye. A church cannot revive them afterwards.

outcomes.text: You build the cairn higher. The voice thanks you, and goes.

choices.label: Ask for a last lesson
choices.hint: A last gift, and then a last goodbye.

target.reason: No one here has anything to learn from them.

outcomes.text: "Watch my feet, not my hands." Then the voice is only wind.

choices.label: "Not yet." Walk on
choices.hint: A church can still bring them back.

outcomes.text: The voice says nothing. It doesn't have to.

events.title: The Toll Bridge
events.intro: A rope bridge, a hut, and a man with a crossbow and a ledger. "Toll," he says, and names a sum. It's a lot.

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.hint: Pay it, cross it, forget it.

outcomes.text: He writes your name in the ledger, spelled wrong.

choices.label: Bluff
choices.hint: A banner and a straight face. Luck does the rest.

outcomes.text: He looks at your banner, then at his ledger, and decides it can wait.
"Nice try." He whistles. The hut was bigger than it looked.

effects.victoryText: The ledger is yours now, and so is the strongbox behind it.

choices.label: Ford the river
choices.hint: The cheapest crossing is the coldest.

outcomes.text: Cold, fast and deeper in the middle than anyone admitted.

events.title: The Moneylender
events.intro: A gilded cart with four guards and a man in very good gloves. "Short of coin, captain? My terms are very reasonable."

choices.label: Borrow
choices.hint: Reasonable is his word, not yours. Read what you sign.

outcomes.text: He counts it out twice and smiles once.
You read the terms on the road. Then you read them again.
"Another time." He seems certain there will be one.

choices.label: Rob the cart
choices.hint: Four guards, and they were hired to be good at this.

outcomes.text: The guards were not there for show.

effects.victoryText: The man in good gloves has left his strongbox behind, and a great deal of paper.

events.title: The Drill Yard
events.intro: An abandoned drill yard: straw men, a sand pit, a rack of blunted blades. A sign reads TWO HOURS. NO EXCUSES.

choices.label: Drill until dark
choices.hint: Sore tomorrow. Better the day after.

outcomes.text: By sundown everyone is sore and nobody is slower.
Real beds. Lumpy, but real.

events.title: A Quiet Road
events.intro: Nothing on this road but birdsong and an old well. Nobody complains.

outcomes.text: A long drink and a short sleep.
You make good time.
